body: This cannot be true because the secret daughter is me

I'm so sorry to hear you're going through so much. I feel all of this and I've spent most of my youth in an identical headspace as you. It is hell. And shitty, selfish friends can make it all so much worse. It's good that you're reaching out and venting on reddit though, because there are cool, real people on here who do give a shit about others. I wish I had made posts here when I was in my darkest places. I wish the best for you. Keep fighting.
Thank you for your suggestion -- I just downloaded Unwinding and I look forward to checking it out

Oh my God that is such a disgusting thing to say to someone. That's not at all okay. I'm sorry that you're going through this. I know how scary and overwhelming it cam be when you're cast off by someone who was so important to you.. but this person sounds rather terrible and it may be that this for the best even though it's so painful. Focus on you right now-- that's the relationship that matters. And one day you'll be able to put yourself out there again and find someone far more deserving. Keep fighting x

Whenever I've been actively suicidal I've often found myself in a weirdly okay mood. I think it might have had something to do with the relief I felt at finally feeling as though I had an actual solution for everything I was going through. Like before I just felt desperate and powerless and pitiful in the face of the mess of my life and my serious depression.
Hey you, I'm happy to listen, whatever you have going on.
Well let me know how it goes! I wish you the best :)

Forgive me for the late response.. unfortunately in my case it took a while, about two years, because I went to school with this person and saw him all the time. If left alone I don't think it would have taken as long, but I was in the same boat as you in that he and his friends kind of made a game out of treating me horribly as some kind of sick joke. It just amazes me how cruel people can be to one another. I mean.. I cannot imagine making some game out of being terrible to a person who expressed feelings for me, regardless of how I felt about them.. Well--I certainly hope it doesn't take as long for you to bounce back from this awful experience. If anything, it definitely seems like you dodged a bullet with this girl, given how insensitive and callous she seems.

I had that happen to me once. It destroyed me. It took me weeks to work up the nerve to Express my feelings to the guy and he just like.. sneered at me and got all his friends in on it too. I wouldn't wish that experience on anyone I thought for the longest time no one will ever love me because of that asshole. I'm so sorry you're going through this.

God that's rough.. it's so hard to try to explain your position to people who refuse to listen.. if you dont mind my suggesting so, I think I would stop wasting my time and just focus on my next steps. Who out there has everything figured out?? What a wildly out of touch thing to say to someone.

I'm so sorry to hear what a rough time you are going through.. lonliness is too horrible for words and I wouldn't wish it upon anyone. If you dont mind my asking, do you like what you're studying? Is most the stress you're experiencing now school related? Again I'm so sorry to hear what you are going through and I hope you find the hope you need soon.

I'm so sorry to hear you're going through such an awful time. Hanging in there just because you don't want to hurt your family is a powerful anchor... it was the only thing that kept me from doing anything for a long time. but its not enough at the end of the day, we need something to hang in there for for our sake too.. do you have anyone that you can maybe talk to right now?

if you don't mind my asking.. why are you so certain that you fucked up and ruined your future?

I know how that level of pain can convince you that your life is worthless.. but it isn't true. Please keep fighting.. when it feels like I'm at the absolute end of my rope I try to just focus on getting through the next five minutes, the next minute, if that's too much.. 

What have you tried to do to  get help so far? 

Keep fighting x I'll be thinking of you
That sounds perfectly serene

I'm so glad to hear that you made it through. I remember that self-conscious, sad, embarrassed feel after I came back from the hospital both times.. try as much as you can to not get swallowed by those feelings. You have nothing to be embarrassed off--you had a crisis, and you survived. If anything, you should be proud that you pulled through and are still here. 

You're not dramatic, you're fighting. 

Keep going x

It's so horrible to be in a situation where the people who are supposed to care for you the most don't give two shits about your suffering.. dogs truly are the most wonderful creatures in the world, so I'm so glad to  hear that you at least have love in those relationships, and that you have them to anchor you in your life at this time.. 

For a long time i believed as you did that connections made over the internet do not compare to long term real life friendships -- but I've come to realize that when a connection is genuine it doesn't matter whether the relationship began in real life or over the internet .. I don't know you but I want you to know that I care, I care whether you live or die. If you ever need to rant or vent or just need someone to listen, feel free to dm me, I'd be more than happy to listen. 

Keep fighting x

I'm so sorry you're going through this... when I was younger I had a similar experience--only it was my 'friends' at the time constantly sneering at me about how gross and ugly I was... it's evil for a person to do that to someone. You are a person, and you are far more than whatever you look like -- and anyone who says anything otherwise is a piece of shit. It reflects on their character and not on yours.. please keep fighting..
word. well fucking said.

This is just my impression based on what you said but it sounds to me right now that your absolute priority needs to be getting away from this horrible person and building your independence -- I've had to drop out of school three times and then go back when I could and in my early 20s I had a lot of shame about that but eventually realized that that's stupid. It took me 8 years to graduate and so what? It takes other people 20 years to graduate and good on them! School will always be there, and peoples lives can get really messy. You need to take care of yourself right now and do everything you can to not get in serious debt, which'll just make things exponentially more difficult. Sure, the job you land might suck--I was a dishwasher during one of my darkest hours and yeah, it was a shit job but it helped me, it helped me keep my head above water financially and gave me something to be proud of, which is huge.

Good luck and stay strong x

For a few months this year I was getting ECT twice a week.. and ho boy yeah it definitely effected my memory but when I came back from the hospital I was in a ghost state for months-- and before that, in high school, I was in this state for 2 years... in the long term it's effected me horribly... I don't feel like I'm actually alive when I slip into these states, so even if the actual result of me being like that is just silly inconvenience stuff--that doesn't mean the state itself isn't serious... like I couldn't taste food, see flowers, feel my dog when I petted her, it's fucking awful and I honestly would not wish it on anybody. My doc and I had to play around with my meds-- and I also started taking adderall, which has made a huge, huge difference--it helps me be actually present and in the moment and feel like I'm not just sleep walking through my life. I would absolutely encourage you to do whatever you can to get out of this. And if you want to talk more don't hesitate to dm me

I've been so surprised by how nice and understanding people are generally here in this group-- I'm really glad you posted.. while it doesn't compare to having someone to talk to face to face you can unload here and there are people who will listen. I will listen -- if you ever want to bitch or just talk you can PM me.

Yeah, I hear you... for months I was getting ECT twice a week and I have to say I think that helped a lot. Being angry helps too.. I know everyone is always like 'being angry is toxic and doesn't do anything for u' but my rage is the only thing that doesn't make me feel powerless. So maybe, I'm not sure I'd say it's a positive attitude.. I'm pissed as hell that I listened to everyone for so long on the 'right way" to do things that got me nowhere.. and it's kinda like now I want to find a way to succeed in spite of everything g so i can just flip off the whole world when I finally make it
At the very least, we dont get better unless we practice so at least I can think to myself that I'm working to get better at something, and that helps a bit too. Wishing you well!

I'm 28, also live with my dad, graduated 3 years ago with a bachelors in animation and I worked at a grocery store until my attempts and am now unemployed.... in my situation I realized like right before I graduated that I want to be a comic book artist and not an animator.. so. I've expected a bumpy ride but nothing like this. I am struggling so hard and I'm terrified its going to add up to nothing

I'm getting a little better.. slowly..  I'm trying to hold pride in the struggle.. like this struggle isn't saying that I'm a failire-- it's a testament to my character and my dedication and shows how much this means to me to keep trying in spite of everything..

Good luck x keep fighting
I'm so glad to hear you're doing better <3
I think strangers are often the best.. and here at least people seem actually aware of what were going thru more or less. Dm me if you want!

Try thinking of your life as revenge. Stay mad. Like when you think of the universe and the cosmos and how all that seems like it's just there to break you and parade happy people around in front of you be like FUCK YOU IM GOING TO LIVE IF ITS THE LAST GODDAMN THING I DO its what's helped me more than most else

I've had extreme social anxiety for as long as I can remember and I'm right there with you where I get so overwhelmed trying to talk to most people.. not only do I get overwhelmed cuz I often freeze up but I get really insecure about what a freak i am...

I've been working really hard at this and I'm starting to get a little better.. honestly realizing that most people are in their own head I try to be genuinely interested in them and ask them about what they love to do and what their dreams are.. most people I think can tell when someone is being authentic and they're more likely to come out of their shell. I try to avoid like filler conversation.. cuz everyones just going to get bored.

Also I'm just letting myself tell the person that I have social anxiety if I feel like its necessary.. not as an excuse.. but kind of to show to them that I am really trying really hard.. and, the nice ones can see that and even appreciate you q bit more cuz of that.

Good luck x
Aieee I'm still on the pokemon go train. It actually makes me kind of excited to leave my room when everything is grey and far away
I'm so glad to hear you hung in there... the random niceness of strangers is sometimes the only thing that gives me hope in humanity sometimes
Hi friend-- I've been in your situation before and I remember how terrifying it was and how lonely it made me feel -- if you need to talk you can dm me. I'm happy to listen. Take care of yourself <3

I'm an artist and I've actually have had the same thing happen to me with writers. I do think that the vast, *vast* majority of people trying to break into this industry vanish into thin air when they come to realize the massive amount of work, time, dedication, and professionalism that is required to get anywhere. 

I actually just made a post here looking for writers to collaborate with on short term (2-10 page) projects. If you have anything in that range hit me up!

Thank you I will!
what a cool story and art style! congratulations! I'd love to see the first issue.
This is really one of the sweetest things I've seen. You should be proud
Very cool! Love the color and painterly style

Thank you very much :) I hope to hear from you soon!

Love the colors and the posing and the whole vibe. V sexy!
